code: import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}collection-responses`;const getCollectionResponsesByUuid=async uuid=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(`${base_url}reminder-allocations/${uuid}/collection-responses`);return response.data;};const deleteCollectionResponse=async id=>{const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+"/"+id);return response.data;};const updateCollectionResponseByUuid=async(uuid,body)=>{const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+"/"+uuid,body);return response.data;};const createCollectionResponse=async body=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,body);return response.data;};const collectionResponseService={createCollectionResponse,getCollectionResponsesByUuid,deleteCollectionResponse,updateCollectionResponseByUuid};export default collectionResponseService;
